''See also: [[Zhen of the Masons Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Zhen is a prominent member and leader within the [[Masons]], an organization that functions as part of the [[Consultant's Guild]]. The [[Masons]] specialize in undercover infiltration, training members in various professional fields—such as alchemy, scholarship, or merchantry—to serve as experts and insiders who can relay information. While the group is known for using disguises to blend into society, they are sometimes criticized for their reliance on these covers. Zhen operates out of a specialized headquarters known as the [[House of the Masons]], which features deceptive entrances and hidden compartments. As a seasoned figure within the [[Guild]], Zhen has experience training others and possesses a sharp, often critical personality. He is capable of using various tools for defense or combat, including knives and kitchen implements. Despite his role, he occasionally shows hesitation or concern regarding the consequences of certain actions taken by other members of the [[Council]]. His leadership and influence are established through his long history with the [[Masons]] and his interactions with other specialized groups like the [[Gardeners]] and the [[Architects]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Zhen is an elderly [[Mason]] who possesses a mustache. This individual carries two [[steel]] knives.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a teacher to [[Shera]] and [[Lucan]], Zhen imparts lessons on the importance of sounding confident even when lacking knowledge. The owner of the [[House of the Masons]] is known to ask questions regarding future actions and the progress of others.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Zhen served as a teacher to [[Shera]]. Additionally, [[Lucan]] underwent training with Zhen prior to [[Meia]]'s arrival on the island. Zhen was also present in a room alongside [[Kerian]] and [[Tyril]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Zhen is a fighter who utilizes [[steel]] knives in combat. In battle, this individual also employs a soup bowl to serve as a shield.}}

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Zhen of the [[Masons]] served as a teacher to [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 4</ref> A man with a mustache, Zhen once lifted [[Shera]] into the air by her armpits.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 5</ref> During their lessons, Zhen taught [[Shera]] that one should sound confident even when lacking knowledge on a subject.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c7">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 7</ref> As the owner of the [[House of the Masons]], Zhen was found waiting in a room alongside [[Kerian]] and [[Tyril]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c13">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 13</ref> A fighter who utilizes two [[steel]] knives, Zhen eventually inquired about the next course of action.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c13" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c15">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 15</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Before [[Meia]] arrived on the island, [[Lucan]] underwent training with Zhen.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c7">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 7</ref> Zhen maintains a house that contains racks of dresses.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c18">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 18</ref> Despite this, Zhen possesses nothing capable of destroying the Heart.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c20">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 20</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Zhen of the Masons|Zhen]] has nothing to destroy the Heart.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c20" />}}</li>
